cipher.name: VowelRot13ConsonantKeep
cipher.idea: To ensure perfect implementation correctness and high reasoning capability, we keep all consonants, digits, spaces, and punctuation completely unchanged. We only apply a ROT13-like shift to the vowels (A, E, I, O, U) by shifting them forward by 2 positions in the vowel sequence (A->I, E->O, I->U, O->A, U->E), preserving case. This is extremely simple, highly readable, and easy for the model to compute without errors.
cipher.encrypt_rules: Leave all consonants, digits, spaces, and punctuation unchanged. For vowels, shift them forward by 2 positions in the cyclic sequence [A, E, I, O, U] (and [a, e, i, o, u] for lowercase). Specifically: a->i, e->o, i->u, o->a, u->e, and A->I, E->O, I->U, O->A, U->E.
cipher.decrypt_rules: Leave all consonants, digits, spaces, and punctuation unchanged. For vowels, shift them backward by 2 positions in the cyclic sequence [A, E, I, O, U] (and [a, e, i, o, u] for lowercase). Specifically: i->a, o->e, u->i, a->o, e->u, and I->A, O->E, U->I, A->O, E->U.
